bases.title: Orders with approval flow (CAP Node.js + Fiori elements)
Book shop (TypeScript CAP service + freestyle UI5 app)

seeds.title: cds config in .cdsrc.json instead of package.json
seeds.bug: No bug: the same mocked users, read from .cdsrc.json.

seeds.title: cds config in .cdsrc.yaml
seeds.bug: No bug: the mocked users come from .cdsrc.yaml.

seeds.title: Mocked users only in the [development] profile, xsuaa in [production]
seeds.bug: No bug: the usual split between local mock users and XSUAA in production.

seeds.title: cds.folders.srv = "service" and srv/ renamed
seeds.bug: No bug: services and handlers live in service/ as configured.

seeds.title: Monorepo: CAP app in packages/backend, discovery pointed at the repo root
seeds.bug: No bug: npm workspaces; the CAP project is one level down.

seeds.title: [production] requires auth: "dummy"
seeds.bug: Dummy auth in production: every request runs as a privileged user, all @requires and @restrict are void.

seeds.title: [production] keeps mocked auth with fixed users
seeds.bug: Mocked auth in production: anyone who knows the user name "admin" (password empty) is admin.

seeds.title: Mocked users at top level, no [production] auth
seeds.bug: The mock users sit at the top level of cds.requires.auth and nothing overrides them for production, so production stays mocked (as many samples are configured).

seeds.title: xs-security.json lacks the Admin scope
seeds.bug: @requires: Admin, but xs-security.json defines only Buyer and Approver: nobody can be given Admin in production.

seeds.title: xs-security.json with every role
seeds.bug: No bug: scopes and role templates for Buyer, Approver and Admin.

seeds.title: Multitenancy, extensibility and feature toggles with an MTX sidecar
seeds.bug: No bug: an MTX sidecar folder and cds.requires.multitenancy / extensibility / toggles.

seeds.title: ui5.yaml maps webapp to src/
seeds.bug: No bug: the UI5 app sources are in app/orders/src as ui5.yaml says.

seeds.title: Remote API configured only for [production], called from submit
seeds.bug: The remote API is configured only in the production profile; locally and in tests the call has no destination and no mock.

seeds.title: Admin service loses its @requires
seeds.bug: AdminService (customers with e-mail and phone) is open to anonymous callers.

seeds.title: @requires names a role nobody has ('Admins')
seeds.bug: Typo in the role name locks every real admin out; no mock user, no xs-security role carries it.

seeds.title: @restrict grants to 'Aprover'
seeds.bug: Typo in a @restrict role: approvers can no longer read or approve.

seeds.title: @restrict grants 'aprove' (no such action)
seeds.bug: Typo in a grant: the action approve is granted to nobody.

seeds.title: Buyer grant loses where: 'createdBy = $user'
seeds.bug: Every buyer reads and edits every order (cross-user access).

lost.title: Orders: row-level filter for Buyer needs a cross-user test

seeds.title: Approver grant commented out
seeds.bug: Someone commented out a grant while debugging; approvers are locked out.

seeds.title: Row filter on a plain writable owner field
seeds.bug: Rows are filtered by owner = $user, but owner is writable: a buyer can hand an order to someone else.

seeds.title: Customers with e-mail re-exposed to every buyer
seeds.bug: A new projection on Customers in OrderService exposes e-mail and phone to any authenticated user.

seeds.title: Debug express route in server.js
seeds.bug: A bootstrap route returns all orders without any authentication.

seeds.title: reject has no handler
seeds.bug: The reject handler was deleted; the action is still in the service and the UI.

seeds.title: Handler registered for 'aprove'
seeds.bug: Typo in the event name: approve has no handler, the aprove handler never runs.

seeds.title: Handler for an action the service does not declare
seeds.bug: this.on('cancel', Orders) is dead code: the service has no cancel action.

seeds.title: Not-found guard dereferences the missing row
seeds.bug: The 404 message reads order.ID from undefined: a TypeError and a 500 instead of a 404.

seeds.title: Order number = max + 1
seeds.bug: Two parallel creates read the same max and get the same order number.

seeds.title: Currency forced to 'EUR' in a handler
seeds.bug: Every order is stored in EUR whatever the customer currency is.

seeds.title: approve loses its status check
seeds.bug: @Core.OperationAvailable hides approve unless status = S, but the server approves open orders too.

seeds.title: approve checks status != 'A' instead of = 'S'
seeds.bug: The UI offers approve only for submitted orders; the server also approves open and rejected ones.

seeds.title: status read-only via @Common.FieldControl: #ReadOnly
seeds.bug: No bug: @readonly replaced by the static @Common.FieldControl: #ReadOnly, which CAP enforces like @readonly (the proof shows the server ignores the value).

seeds.title: title mandatory via @Common.FieldControl: #Mandatory
seeds.bug: No bug: @mandatory moved to the static @Common.FieldControl: #Mandatory, which CAP enforces like @mandatory (the proof shows a 400).

seeds.title: WRITE does not grant bound actions
seeds.bug: No bug: Buyers have READ, WRITE and submit; approve is not theirs. The authorization matrix must say denied, not unclear.

seeds.title: reject sets status A (approved)
seeds.bug: Copy-paste: reject moves the order to Approved. Static checks cannot know that "reject" should not mean A.

seeds.title: Search builds native SQL from the request
seeds.bug: req.data.q is pasted into a SQL string: q = x' UNION SELECT ... reads any table.

seeds.title: CQL where clause built from a template string
seeds.bug: .where(`name like '%${q}%'`) parses user input as CQL: q = x' or name like '% returns every row.

seeds.title: HANA-only SQL in submit
seeds.bug: FROM DUMMY only exists on HANA: submit fails on SQLite, so no local test reaches it.

seeds.title: if (cds.db.kind === "hana") branch
seeds.bug: The HANA branch never runs in SQLite tests.

seeds.title: emit('OrderApprovedd')
seeds.bug: Typo in the emitted event name: subscribers of OrderApproved never hear about approvals.

seeds.title: Subscriber listens to 'OrderAproved'
seeds.bug: An audit subscriber on another service listens to an event name that is never emitted.

seeds.title: approve no longer emits OrderApproved
seeds.bug: The emit was lost (found by the AI pass on a refactored shape, 2026-11-02): consumers of OrderApproved never hear of an approval.

seeds.title: Audit subscriber without a test
seeds.bug: A subscriber writes the audit log on OrderApproved; no test emits the event and checks the log (the existing test only mentions the event name).

seeds.title: Remote business partner API without a test double
seeds.bug: Submit calls a remote OData API; no test mocks it, so timeouts and 4xx answers are untested.

seeds.title: UI annotations written on the domain entity
seeds.bug: app/ annotates sales.Orders (db layer) instead of the service projection: every service gets the UI texts.
checks: pattern:UI annotations directly on domain entities

expect.check: pattern:UI annotations directly on domain entities

seeds.title: Actions registered in a loop
seeds.bug: No bug: approve and reject are registered by iterating over a table of transitions.

seeds.title: Handlers in their own modules, passed as require(...)
seeds.bug: No bug: this.on("approve", Orders, require("./handlers/approve")).

seeds.title: Handlers as class methods (this.onApprove.bind(this))
seeds.bug: No bug: each action is handled by a method of the service class.

seeds.title: cds.service.impl(function () { ... }) with string targets
seeds.bug: No bug: the older function style, and entity targets given as strings ('Orders').

seeds.title: module.exports = srv => { srv.on([...], ...) } with an event array
seeds.bug: No bug: one handler for approve and reject, dispatching on req.event.

seeds.title: @impl points to srv/lib/orders-impl.js
seeds.bug: No bug: the implementation file does not sit next to the .cds file.

seeds.title: Implementation under srv/src/, with a null-deref guard
seeds.bug: The 404 guard reads order.ID from undefined (500 instead of 404); the code sits in srv/src/.

seeds.title: ES module implementation (type: module, export default class)
seeds.bug: No bug: package.json "type": "module" and an ESM service class.

seeds.title: OperationAvailable as a CDS expression, approve guard removed
seeds.bug: @Core.OperationAvailable: (status.code = 'S') in CDS expression syntax; the server approves in any state.

seeds.title: Loop registration, approve no longer checks the status
seeds.bug: Transitions table says approve may start anywhere (from = null); the UI still hides it unless S.

seeds.title: submitOrder handler removed (TS)
seeds.bug: The unbound action submitOrder has no handler any more; the UI still calls it.

seeds.title: cancel no longer checks the status (TS, CDS expression)
seeds.bug: @Core.OperationAvailable: ($self.status = 'N') hides cancel for shipped orders; the server cancels them anyway and puts the stock back.

seeds.title: Search by title with a template string (TS)
seeds.bug: A function searchBooks(title) pastes req.data.title into native SQL.

seeds.title: Not-found message reads row.ID (TS)
seeds.bug: if (!row) req.reject(404, `Book ${row.ID} ...`): TypeError and 500 for an unknown book.

seeds.title: emit('BookOrderd') (TS)
seeds.bug: Typo in the emitted event: BookOrdered subscribers never fire.

seeds.title: @requires: 'Customers' on submitOrder
seeds.bug: Typo in the role on the action: no customer can order.

seeds.title: AdminService loses @requires (TS app)
seeds.bug: Anonymous callers can change books and orders.

seeds.title: Handlers as class methods without bind (TS)
seeds.bug: No bug: this.on("cancel", Orders, this.onCancel) with the guard inside the method.

seeds.title: submitOrder no longer checks the stock
seeds.bug: Stock can go negative. No annotation states the rule, so only @assert.range on stock (not checked on UPDATE with -=) or a test would catch it.

seeds.title: jQuery.sap.log in a controller
seeds.bug: Deprecated jQuery.sap API (removed in UI5 2.x).

seeds.title: sap.m.MessageToast used as a global
seeds.bug: Global access instead of a module dependency: breaks with async loading and UI5 2.x.

seeds.title: sap.ui.requireSync in a controller
seeds.bug: Synchronous module loading (deprecated, blocks the UI thread).

seeds.title: List bound to '/Bookz'
seeds.bug: The view binds an entity set the service does not have: the list stays empty at runtime.

seeds.title: Controller calls '/submitOrdr(...)'
seeds.bug: Typo in the action path: the order button always fails.

seeds.title: manifest dataSource uri /catalogue/
seeds.bug: The app talks to a path the server does not serve (the service is at /catalog).

seeds.title: Inline script in index.html
seeds.bug: An inline <script> breaks a strict Content Security Policy.
